description: A GraphQL response document, as defined by the GraphQL specification.

data.description: Result of the executed operation, keyed by the response keys of the root selection set (an alias, where used, otherwise a field name). Absent if the query failed before execution began.

errors.description: Errors raised while handling the query. May accompany partial data.

locations.description: Locations in the query that relate to the error.

path.description: Path to the response field that raised the error.

extensions.description: Values outside the scope of the GraphQL specification.
